heading.title: Suits by or against the government or public officers in their official capacity

article.title: Fixing of day for appearance on behalf of Government.
article.content:
5Fixing of day for appearance on behalf of Government.

Order 27, Rule 5
The Court, in fixing the day for 3[the Government] to answer to the plaint, shall allow a reasonable time for the necessary communication with the Government through the proper channel, and for the issue of instructions to the 7[Government pleader] to appear and answer on behalf of 8[the Government] 9***, and may extend the time at its discretion 10[but the time so extended shall not exceed two months in the aggregate].

10 Ins. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 76 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
3 Subs. by A.O. 1937, for “the Secretary of State for India in Council”.
7 Subs. by the A.O. 1950, for “Crown pleader” which had been subs. by the A. O. 1937, for “Government pleader”.
8 Subs. by the A.O. 1937, for “the said Secretary of State, for India in Council”.
9 The words “or the Government,” omitted by the A. O. 1948.
